title: Builder BLD-902: Owner walk-through

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-902.

detail:
BZ Hardening, pass BLD-902 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-902). Owner walk-through. Scope: staging. Build: Five owners each build a page from a blank Space while we watch. Log every hesitation and failed find. Promote any Layer 2 control used by 3 of 5 into Layer 1. Done when: Every owner publishes without help; No control is searched for in ⌘K by more than 2 owners. Gates: Pass probes, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: BLD-901. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

Tooling is built (2026-11-09): the observer logs one session per owner in docs/builder-walkthrough/sessions.json (shape in session.example.json) and `pnpm walkthrough:builder` prints the verdict: who published without help, any control searched for in ⌘K by more than two owners, and the Layer 2 controls used by three of five owners, which move into Layer 1 (lib/builder/walkthrough.ts). The row stays open: it closes when five real owners have been watched and the log passes. It needs the owner's choice of the five people and sessions on production with the owners' own Spaces (no staging, Daniel's rule); an agent cannot stand in for them. ROSTER (Daniel 2026-11-09: he recruits, a session each, five owners). Owner 1: House of Fates (recruiting). Owners 2 to 5: not chosen yet. How each session runs, what the observer logs and how a session is entered: docs/builder-walkthrough/README.md. Log each session in docs/builder-walkthrough/sessions.json as it is watched; the row closes when five are logged and pnpm walkthrough:builder passes.
